ambiguities: The passage's closing imagery (Odette as the radiant source of the 'vérité qui rayonnait' that dispels Swann's dread of isolation) could be read as a narrated elevation of Odette in her own right, but the preceding meditation on love's arbitrariness ('il n'est même pas besoin qu'il nous plût... plus ou même autant que d'autres') frames this radiance as a projection of Swann's anxious need rather than an endorsed judgment about Odette's qualities; left unscored to avoid double-counting the already-captured elevation of Swann (E2) and to stay conservative under this layered irony.

Rémi's rejoinder to Swann ('Je ne vois pas comment cette dame pourrait être froissée...') mildly and correctly contradicts his employer's anxious premise, but this reads as procedural dialogue rather than a socially consequential status shift for Rémi, so it was not scored as an event.
